title: WaitlistCommandsOfferExpiryV1
description: Durable scheduled-job contract (spec 11 §5.1) fired by the scheduled-job poller at/after an offer's deadline, routed to the waitlist consumer (consumer 'waitlist.processor'). Instructs the worker to expire the still-outstanding offer, release its temporary hold, and re-match the freed opening. Idempotent and self-settling: if the offer was already accepted/declined/expired the handler is a no-op. Carries only the offer id (Inv-12); the handler reloads the offer/enrollment to reconstruct the re-match criteria.

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.commands.offer_expiry.v1' for this contract.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. All consumer-side writes are scoped to this tenant (Inv-13).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (nullable).

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause (nullable for scheduled triggers).

offer_id.description: Stable id of the waitlist_offers row whose deadline elapsed.
